text: The sourdough bread and almond croissants here are simply out of this world! Freshly baked and warm. Staff was very courteous.
Extremely disappointed. Ordered a birthday cake for 8 PM delivery, it arrived at 9:45 PM completely melted and smashed! ruined our party.
The hot chocolate was completely spilled inside the paper bag. No protective seal or proper cup holder. Packaging was terrible!
Cozy ambiance, lovely jazz music, and delicious blueberry cheesecake. Best neighborhood cafe in town.
Pastries were fresh and tasty, but ₹380 for a small slice of tiramisu feels a bit expensive compared to other bakeries nearby.
Unacceptable hygiene lapse! Found a long hair strand baked directly inside the chocolate muffin. When I showed the staff, they were indifferent and rude.
Chef was kind enough to bake an eggless walnut brownie specially on request. Excellent customer service and personal touch!
Food took 75 minutes to arrive. The garlic bread was cold and rock hard by the time the rider delivered it.
Clean store, heavenly aroma, and impeccable packaging for dry cookies. Will definitely order again for festive gifting.
Coffee is decent, but seating area is too cramped on Sunday evenings. Impossible to find a quiet corner to work.
Charged me twice on UPI scanner and manager refused to refund on spot, asked me to wait 7 banking days. Rude behaviour!
Consistently great quality for 2 years now. Their cinnamon rolls are unbeatable!
